increment: Live eval and Function compilation charging; top-level daemon and worker wiring pending
method: Same-host serial release pair with identical fixture copied to archived baseline source, separate targets. Both built before the final pair; no concurrent agent builds or tests during timing. One warmup and five measured rounds per case, median. Outer source construction/compilation and realm creation/linking excluded. vm.run includes nested source preparation, compilation, relinking, execution, and outcome rendering. Exact successful outcomes checked after timing.
command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test --manifest-path rust/engine/Cargo.toml --locked --release -p ironhorse-262 --test runtime_compile_bench -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
limitations: Single-host medians do not establish statistical significance. No eval speedup claim; final eval at 4k is approximately unchanged and Function at 4k about10% slower.

Added compilation charges are deliberate policy changes; old/new raw charges must not be described as identical. A failed live source admission records its full reservation before the host rejects it, so the observed bill can exceed the host threshold. The explicit compiler raw allowance separately bounds its recorded capacity.

Refusal cases change outcomes: baseline 1k/10k complete, baseline 1M already aborts later; candidate refuses all. Timed source string allocation/decoding remain, so earlier refusal is not constant-time VM admission or same-work acceleration.
Byte identity is verified by the compiler corpus; runtime tests separately compare results and exact charge deltas, including nested eval and caught syntax errors.
All 1287 conformance tests pass in release. The copied-iterator-setter recursion test stack-overflows in debug on both baseline 861dedcd7 and candidate; retained evidence below.
Frozen meter-1 snapshots/stores fail closed. Schema-only tests use clearly labeled temporary current-cost derivatives, never an automatic production cost-table upgrade.
Top-level daemon and worker compilation remain open after this increment.

validation.note: VM full run passed all integration tests; its registry sorting unit failure was corrected, then all 162 library and 9 registry tests passed. Totals deduplicate registry tests. Snapshot golden re-pinned only for cost-table v2, with old hash reconstructed by changing just the marker.
